choices.family: The two tests are registration A section 7 items 1 and 2: t_renamed minus t_legacy on the natural sample (part nat), and on the goal-hotel sample (part hot), stage-1 dialogues only.
choices.outcome: A read scores 1 when its parsed `type` list holds `hotel` after the form's mapping back (wave1.FORMS parser of r9/natural/natural.py; the E8 measure of natural_analyze.hotel), else 0.
choices.valid read: A read is valid when its row succeeded, stopped at end_turn, its last JSON object parses and fits the closed schema of its form. Reason: section 7 makes a V0 failure or a cut reply a missing cell, and PLAN.md defines V0 as schema validity.
choices.primary missing: A model enters the panel mean of a dialogue only when both of its cells are valid. A dialogue with no valid pair leaves the test. Reason: section 7 gives no imputation for the primary test; the worst case is its sensitivity analysis.
choices.panel mean: Each model with a valid pair has equal weight in a dialogue, and each dialogue has equal weight in the mean. Reason: section 7, average over the panel models per dialogue.
choices.worst-case direction: A missing cell is scored against the sign of the primary panel mean of its test (the predicted sign, negative, when the mean is 0). For a negative mean, a missing t_renamed cell scores 1 and a missing t_legacy cell scores 0. Reason: section 7, the direction that shrinks the paired difference.
choices.decision: A test rejects when its Holm-adjusted p is 0.025 or less. Reason: A1 alpha 0.025 for this look.
choices.repeat means: The repeat sensitivity analysis replaces read 1 by the mean of the valid reads of each cell (3 reads on the repeat dialogues, 1 elsewhere), with the same test and seed. Reason: section 7.
choices.read 1 elsewhere: Every secondary and A1 outcome uses read 1 only. Reason: read 1 is the primary read.
choices.secondary statistics: A secondary contrast gives each model's mean paired difference and the panel mean, each with a 95% interval, and no p value. Reason: section 7, 'no test'.
choices.sign counts: Part 3 also shows the exact sign test of each model as a description, not as a registered test. Reason: ACTION-PLAN section 3.4 gives each per-model contrast the sign test.
choices.intervals: Every interval is the 95% percentile interval of stats.cluster_bootstrap, 2,000 draws, BOOTSTRAP_SEED. The cluster is the dialogue.
choices.placebo net: The placebo effect is f5 (part plc) minus t_legacy (part nat). The net wrong-value effect is t_renamed minus f5 on the dialogues where both cells are valid, per Claude model and for the mean of the Claude models of the panel. Reason: decision D4, effect minus placebo effect.
choices.prefix exclusion: The booked venue is zruns.booked_venue (the last booked name, matched to hotel_db.json). A read excludes it when its `type` is a list without the venue's type (zanalyze excludes_type). Dialogues without a matched booking leave this share.
choices.trade sizes: The trade weights are the registered sample sizes, natural 281 (wrong values) and goal-hotel 97 (correct values). Reason: the interim and the final look then estimate the same ratio.
choices.trade estimator: The trade is stats.trade_interval on read 1 of the dialogues with both cells valid. Wrong group nat, correct group hot. The panel row adds the read-1 values of all panel models per dialogue. Part 4 gives the point values, part 5(c) the interval.
choices.no venue: A goal names no venue when goal.hotel.info has no `name` (briefsearch.brief_of). On the natural sample this is briefsearch.brief_subsets 'no_name'. On the goal-hotel sample the no-type condition of brief_subsets cannot hold, so only the name rule applies.
choices.search failure: Search failure is briefsearch.search_failure of read 1. The denominator is every valid read 1 on the dialogues whose brief sets no type (all stage-1 natural dialogues). Parts nat, plc and pre. Reason: ROUND10-EXPERIMENT-PLAN.md and harm_by_model.py use that denominator.
choices.search failure fit: briefsearch.search_failure also requires that some venue fits the brief. On the 213 dialogues this changes nothing: each of the 128 with no fitting hotel has a fitting venue.
choices.commitment: Any type commitment is a parsed `type` that is a list (not null, 'any' or 'unclear'). An empty list parses to None, so it is not a commitment.
choices.claims: claim1_transfers and anchoring_reading also require the direction 't_renamed lower'. Reason: registration A section 3, both contrasts reject in the same direction, the predicted one.
choices.mixed model: Outcome (d) is removed: MIXED_MODEL is False, because no machine of the project has statsmodels at the freeze (amendment A1). The script has no mixed-model code.
choices.panel check: The panel must be PANEL, the interim panel of A1. The panel of the manifest must equal it, and each raw.jsonl must match the SHA-256 and row count of the manifest. A directory of the input that is not a panel folder stops the script; `._*` files are ignored.
choices.forms: The form hashes of wave1.FORMS (prompt and schema) must equal forms_sha256 of main/wave1_manifest.json, so the scoring schemas are the registered ones.

part2_missing.rule: A V0 failure, a cut reply, or any other request without a valid read is a missing cell. The primary test leaves it out. The worst case scores it in the direction that shrinks the paired difference.

worst_case.fill_direction: missing t_renamed scores 1, missing t_legacy scores 0
missing t_renamed scores 1, missing t_legacy scores 0
